title: Income Tax Act 2023 Section 204 – Tax VAT Point
main_content: Section 204 - Investigation and Inspection (1) The Inspecting Income-tax Authority may make such Investigation and inspection as it thinks fit in relation to any person or any other person who is assessable to tax under this Act or in respect of whom it is deemed to be liable to tax, or such investigation and inspection may be made by such person or establishment or such investigation and inspection, may direct any other person or institution concerned to appear before him at the specified time and place to deliver or take measures to deliver any documents relating to any information or income under the control of the said person or institution. (2) The Board shall for the purposes of this section, prepare a manual to be followed for the purposes of investigation and inspection.
